concept.title: Notes and admonitions
concept.shortdesc: DITA note types map onto two GOV.UK components: inset text for neutral notes and warning text for anything that demands attention.

conbody.p: Neutral types render as inset text:
conbody.note: A plain note renders as inset text with no label.
A tip renders the same way — the styling keeps advice unobtrusive.
conbody.p: Warning-family types render as warning text, with the icon and a visually hidden label announced to screen readers:
conbody.note: A warning uses the warning text component.
A caution renders identically, with its own hidden label.
Important notes join the warning family.
Danger is the strongest of the set.
